description: Report commit statuses (checks) on OpenVibe.Git (git.openvibe.codes): POST /api/v1/repos/:owner/:name/commits/:sha/statuses with {context, state: pending|success|failure|error, description?, target_url?}. A first-party CI service (Run first) holds this capability for the audience openvibe.git and reports any repository it builds; the owner may report their own. Reads (GET, the latest per context) need no capability on a public repository and git.repo.read on a private one. A change is mergeable only when its required contexts are green.
